title: Drone Barrage on Russia's Leningrad Region as Abu Dhabi Talks Enter Second Day
detail: On Nov 11 the Leningrad region governor said 146 drones were downed over the region; Reuters reported the Ust-Luga port area caught fire with three people injured, and drone debris killed two in Smolensk region. Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia issued shelter alerts and Finland briefly restricted airspace in the eastern Gulf of Finland. Russian strikes hit Kryvyi Rih, Kharkiv and Zaporizhzhia, causing power outages and injuries. Meanwhile the second day of US-mediated talks opened in Abu Dhabi after Zelensky called day one 'constructive and quite substantive'; no outcome had been reported at the time of this update.

media.caption: Russia claims interception of 146 drones in Leningrad region
